title: Add 7visions - Safe Dream Analysis to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [7visions - Safe Dream Analysis](https://www.7visions.fr/app) to chat
- 7visions is a safe AI dream analysis app available on web and Android. Users describe a dream and receive a structured interpretation through seven complementary perspectives: Jungian psychology, Freu

Fixes #11354

gist.headline: Seven ways to dream
gist.blurb: 7visions has joined the garden: a calm little place to bring a strange dream and look at it from seven thoughtful angles. Polli approves of any software that treats the subconscious like a community art project.
gist.summary: Added 7visions, a web and Android AI dream-analysis app that gives users structured dream interpretations through seven complementary perspectives, to the Pollinations app catalog and chat.
gist.impact: People can now discover 7visions through Pollinations and explore dream descriptions with a more structured, multi-perspective interpretation flow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict 7visions as a cozy dream observatory: seven pastel, floating window-panels each showing a gentle symbolic dream image such as a moon, key, flower, staircase, cloud, mirror, and star. Polli, wearing a tiny nightcap and holding a dream journal, warmly examines the panels while code-plants and small flowers grow around a softly glowing retro chat terminal.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art dream observatory where Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears a tiny nightcap and holds a dream journal beside a retro chat terminal; seven floating pastel dream panels show a moon, key, flower, staircase, cloud, mirror, and star, with code-plants and garden flowers below. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, pixel-font text: "7 VISIONS", nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
